Card Q&A.q: Do I or my opponent choose the card to be deleted from their hand when I activate this card's inherited effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If you don't have [Keenan Crier] in play, you may play 1 [Keenan Crier] from your hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] If deleted outside of a battle, your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.
